notes:
Background: Prismfold Labs builds an AI-driven knowledge layer for mid-market B2B apps (customer success + in-app help). Evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Initial interest in Hosted API to get started; pilot -> Dedicated if throughput/costs align.

Key quotes: "We need predictable cost for nightly batch embed jobs and under-100ms retrieval latency for top-k results at 50 QPS" — Head of Product.

POC scope: ingest ~1.6M docs (release notes, KB, tickets), run nightly incremental batch embeddings, serve vector search for product and support flows, integrate with existing vector DB (currently testing Pinecone and self-hosted Milvus). Evaluate: embed throughput, upstream batching options, KV/prefix caching for conversational threads, and regional residency for EU customers.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — wants per-embed and per-search unit economics for 12-month projection. Looking to reduce per-embed cost via batch chunking + cache re-use. Current runbook uses single-threaded embed pipeline (400 docs/min) — target 4x improvement.

Security: requires SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML), audit logs sent to Splunk, KMS keywrap preferred. Data residency for EU subset (customers in DE/FR).

Observations from Hosted POC: embedding job using hosted_api (open-embed-v1) achieved 250 docs/sec in parallelized runner (8 workers) when batched at 256; average embed latency 30-45ms. Vector search (semantic) with redirect fallback to smaller quantized model kept p99 query latency ~180ms without caching; with local prefix cache and 8-shard search layer, tail latency dropped to ~85ms.

Pricing conversations: asked for Dedicated reserved capacity quote for 3 GPU nodes + burst; requested sample TCO for 1-year commit vs pay-as-you-go. Asking Redwood to show model-variant routing savings (hosted -> quantized on Dedicated) in dollar/token.

Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (decision owner), CTO (procurement signoff), SRE (operational constraints), Data Privacy counsel (residency/KMS).

Quick notes: shorthand updates in CRM. Some duplication across threads.
